manaNeeded: {4}{W} or you control two untapped creatures that share a creature type with Stormfront Riders
notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
description:
If you control two untapped creatures that share a creature type with Stormfront Riders, activate Cryptic Gateway by tapping the two creatures, putting Stormfront Riders from your hand onto the battlefield.
Otherwise, cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W}.
Stormfront Riders enters the battlefield, returning itself and any other creature you control from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Cryptic Gateway by tapping the two Soldier tokens, putting Stormfront Riders from your hand onto the battlefield.
Stormfront Riders enters the battlefield, returning itself and a Soldier token from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.
